Synopsis:
The player tries to talk to a cursed Flaming Fist, who is currently unable to talk. Fist J'ehlar is presently trying to do the same thing, and responds to the player while trying to keep Cullagh in the loop, i.e. doesn't want to talk over his head and tries to include him in the convo.If the player retrieves his Art's dulcimer and plays it, Cullagh can start to come around and wake up.

Cluster Contexts:
- HAV_CursedFist.json: You find a cursed Flaming Fist who is presently mute or unresponsive; Fist J'ehlar is at the scene trying to reach him while carefully keeping fellow officer Art Cullagh in the loop—J'ehlar pleads gently and avoids talking over Cullagh’s head. On inspection you notice no clear prognosis and recall checks only suggest a possible magical affliction, but you can’t diagnose it. A piece of Art Cullagh’s instrument (a lute/dulcimer) is available: if the player retrieves and plays it, Cullagh can begin to come around and bolt awake, providing a reaction that advances the scene. These excerpts are examples of likely lines and triggers, not an exhaustive list of outcomes.
- HAV_HalsinQuest_AD_BedTalk.json: Halsin talks to J'ehlar about Art's condition. Art is a flaming fist who was caught in the curse and has been rendered largely catatonic. He has important info about thaniel, the spirit of the land.
- HAV_HalsinQuest_Halsin.json: A fallback scene where Halsin has visited Art, the cursed flaming fist in the Last Light Inn, but the player has not yet fulfilled the requirements for the story to progress (waking Art by retrieving his guitar). Halsin needs to speak to Art, and supposes that there must be a way to stir him.
- HAV_CursedFist_Dead_CursedFist.json: This is the speak with dead of a main quest giver in Act 2, Art Cullagh. Art had been sent to investigate Ketheric Thorm and ended up trapped in the shadowfell for 100 years. The purpose of the dialogue is to hint at how to remove the curse.
- HAV_HalsinQuest_Spirit.json: The player tries to interact with Thaniel, the spirit of the land, after Halsin rescues him from the Shadowfell. Thaniel is unconscious/unresponsive however.Later - Thaniel is recovering and able to talk. A somewhat otherworldly, wise far beyond his years 'child'. He instructs you on what comes next/offers his thanks once you have succeeded.

context: Art Cullagh is a Flaming Fist officer who has been rendered mute/catatonic by a magical curse; Fist J'ehlar is at his bedside trying to reach him while carefully keeping Cullagh “in the loop,” gently pleading and avoiding talking over his head. On inspection you notice no obvious physical cause and recall checks only suggest a possible magical affliction—you cannot diagnose it here. A piece of Cullagh’s instrument (a lute/dulcimer) is available nearby; if the player retrieves and plays it, Cullagh can begin to stir and suddenly bolt awake, panicked and mentioning Thaniel. These lines and triggers are examples of likely outcomes, not an exhaustive list.
